Used by scripts/x_post_experiment_commentary.mjs for same-day idempotency (never post twice in one Asia/Tokyo calendar day) and by whoever drafts the next post to see recent real topics/wording and avoid rehashing them. Every entry here is a real, confirmed-posted tweet -- not a draft or a skipped day.
